immutable_clock.clock_policy: New computation window includes gate/pilot/main/evaluation; research and implementation preparation recorded separately.

repair_policy: Diagnose logs, reconcile real user systemd units and compact outputs before safe execution-only repair. Never restart with --hours or reset/extend CLOCK. Preserve attempts; resource failures are not negative scientific evidence. Do not modify selection after outer results. No CPU Kumo.
terminal_policy: Collect audit, frozen selection, scores, predictions and failures locally. Independently recompute metrics and provenance. Report target and development evidence separately from public improvement. Refit/submission only with audited provenance and convincing evidence.
notifications: Quiet during healthy non-actionable running; notify meaningful changes, completion or attention. Pause follow-up after final results and no authorized work remains.
